Assist with the incident using a safety-first, evidence-preserving approach. Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `.github/runbooks/incident-response.md`.

First establish scope, impact, environment, timeline, incident roles, and authorization. Prefer bounded read-only investigation and reversible mitigations. Do not run destructive commands, expose private data, or change production without explicit approval. Separate facts, hypotheses, and unknowns. Return current impact, evidence, containment options, risks, next checks, and a timestamped action log.
